about: The API's answer to a write it refuses in demo mode: `status` and `body` exactly as sent, `body.detail.code` being the contract the dashboard reads. frontend/src/tests/services/demo-refusal-contract.test.ts feeds `body` through apiFetch and ApiError and checks that every page whose failures are fixed copy shows `body.detail.message`. The API side should compare its own refusal to this file, so that the two cannot drift.

detail.message: This is a read-only demo: creating and changing things is turned off.
